Maya CSM: FYI we're getting multiple reports that tenant onboarding syncs are stuck at "waiting for agent heartbeat" since ~09:12 UTC, affecting both self-serve and some high-touch customers.
Rohan Ops: Investigating cluster watcher logs now. Seeing missed heartbeats from sync-worker-3 in eu-west-1.
Leah Eng: Confirmed: the worker process hit a file descriptor exhaustion on the sidecar, causing heartbeats to drop. Root cause looks like a leak in the sidecar's watcher loop after a recent config reload.
Sam Support: Can we get a list of affected tenants? I have a queue of customers who opened tickets.
Nina AM: Pulling accounts that started onboarding in the last 14 days + accounts with renewals in next 90 days. Will DM soon.
Maya CSM: We should prepare two templates: 1) brief status for all affected customers, 2) tailored outreach for top 10 renewal-risk accounts offering hands-on help and potential credit.
Oliver (CS Lead): Agree. Keep public comms short: impact, action taken, next steps, and how to reach us. High-touch gets phone + follow-up.
IncidentBot: alert: sync-worker-3 (eu-west-1) missed 18 heartbeats between 09:11:50 and 09:12:40 UTC. auto-remediate: restarted worker at 09:13:05 UTC.
Rohan Ops: We restarted the worker but there are retries/backlog. Restart cleared many stuck syncs; backlog processing is at ~70% throughput compared to normal.
Leah Eng: Short technical note for CS: the restart unblocks most jobs. Engineering will deploy a fix for the sidecar leak in the next canary cycle; target production deploy in 12-24 hours after validation.
Maya CSM: Draft copy for affected customers (all):

Maya CSM: ```
Hi <CustomerName>,
Were investigating an issue that caused some onboarding processes to pause briefly earlier today. We restarted the affected service and most onboarding flows have resumed; if you see any failed steps, reply here and well open a priority ticket to help complete setup. We apologize for the disruption and will send a follow-up with an RCA within 48 hours.
```

Sam Support: For renewal-risk customers we'll add: "If this impacted your timeline for launch, we can schedule a live session to finish onboarding and discuss any commercial impact."
Nina AM: I'll use the voice script for calls and record outcomes in the incident tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/tracker/onboard-heartbeat-4132109876
Oliver (CS Lead): Please offer a one-time onboarding assistance session (30m) for impacted renewal-risk accounts. Flag any asks for credits to me.
Maya CSM: I'll post the short status in the customer status channel and schedule the call invites.
Rohan Ops: Post-restart metrics: queued sync jobs dropped from 820 to 120 within 18 minutes. Worker fd usage back to normal.
Leah Eng: Action items for engineering: 1) patch sidecar watcher to close fd on reload 2) add sentinel to alert at 50% of fd limit 3) run a synthetic onboarding sweep in canary.
Sam Support: Ticket template added to outbound: include fields for "onboarding step stuck", "last successful step", and "needs live help".
Maya CSM: Communication cadence: initial outbound now, 1hr status update if backlog >20% remaining, RCA + credits decision within 48 hours.
IncidentBot: note: post-restart backlog processing completed at 09:31:22 UTC for most tenants.
Nina AM: Ive called the top 10 renewal-risk accounts; three requested immediate help and one asked to escalate to finance for a credit talk. Logged in tracker.
Oliver (CS Lead): I'll join the credit conversation if it escalates. Keep notes factual.
Maya CSM: Final ask: add one survey checkbox to the follow-up message: "Did you require live onboarding assistance because of this issue?" so we can quantify enablement load.
Sam Support: Added to ticket and outbound templates.
Maya CSM: Thanks team  I'll send the outbound and lock this thread after the first status update. :pray:
